ModMetaData.name: Slot Reservations for Adaptive Storage
ModMetaData.author: 原神高手
ModMetaData.description:
Reserve stack slots in a storage building for specific items.
Example: a shelf with 8 slots keeps 2 slots for meat and 2 for vegetables. The other 4 slots follow the building's normal storage filter. Other items can't take the reserved slots, so the food you care about always has room.
Works with Adaptive Storage Framework buildings and vanilla shelves (Building_Storage). ASF is optional.
Features: - Slot rules gizmo on every storage building. Each rule is a thing filter plus a slot count. - Copy / paste rules between buildings. - Inspect pane shows reserved slots and how many stacks still need to move out. - Stacks that break the rules are hauled to other storage. If nothing else accepts them, or they stay stuck for about 2 in-game hours, they are dropped next to the building. - Hauler-aware: items already on their way count toward slots, so haulers don't overfill. Supports vanilla hauling and Pick Up and Haul. - Translations: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese.
Requires Harmony. Load after Adaptive Storage Framework if you use it.
Source: https://github.com/Kev-Cui/SlotReservationsForASF
